result.title: TabAbax: A Tabular Foundation Model Technical Report
result.summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) enable in-context prediction on unseen tabular datasets without task-specific training. Mechanistic work has shown that increasing the depth of the ICL Transformer yields weak gains, leaving the main headroom for gains in the synthetic pretraining prior and column-row encoder upstream of the ICL backbone. We introduce TabAbax, a TFM built on TabICLv2 that focuses all modifications on these two upstream components. On the prior side, we further improve the quality and complexity of the synthetic pretraining prior. On the encoder side, a two-pass column-row stack strengthens cross-feature interactions before row compression, using learned Fourier scalar encoding from TabFM and Causilo. Evaluations on BeyondArena and TabArena show strong regression-centric gains: TabAbax reaches 1,238 Elo on the 142-dataset BeyondArena suite (10th of 41 evaluated methods), 1,676 Elo on TabArena's overall 51-dataset suite (11th of 99 methods, +115 over TabICLv2), and 2,024 Elo on TabArena's regression benchmark (7th of 99 methods, +336 over TabICLv2, +21 over TabFM). A prior-only ablation confirms the attribution: the improved prior alone yields +228 Elo for regression, demonstrating that prior quality is the dominant knob for improving regression performance.

AI.brief_summary: TabAbax 是一份表格基础模型技术报告：在 TabICLv2 基础上改进合成预训练先验，并用两遍「列-行」编码器加强特征交互，在 BeyondArena 与 TabArena 上以 Elo 呈现以回归为主的提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「加深 ICL backbone 收益微弱、提升预训练先验与上游编码器才是主要空间」的结论，可能与 LVR 中深层或循环计算收益有限、表示质量与训练分布更关键的问题形成类比，可供核查；但表格模态、无视觉或 latent 推理实验，联系较远。
